items.title: Port complete non-MCP CLI and TUI
items.note: Connected native init/list/get/set/delete, config get/set/list, lock/unlock/auth status, import/export, find/search, generate/gen and TOTP output now have focused tests; the reused pinned Go CLI oracle covers connected flows. Git history, recipient management, backup/restore and noninteractive add/new/create are connected with focused Go/Rust checks. Manifest verification, audit view, file add/get/use, editor dispatch, string-reference built-in templates migrate kdf, profile list/add/use, remote status/init, sync, audit export, agent list/whoami, agent profile show/export, share list/revoke, non-broker run, migrate paths/xdg and policy validate/list/apply/remove are now connected in the local integration wave; final native acceptance remains open. Custom templates and full interactive surfaces remain unavailable. The complete command/flag/help/error surface and TUI remain open; blocked status still reflects unmet whole-item dependencies and acceptance, not absence of partial implementation. See resume-20260917.md for exact tested commits and CI limitations.

items.title: Port all MCP stdio tools and framing
items.note: MCP-001 and MCP-004 are implemented; the source-bound catalog retains the full Go schema. Native stdio dispatch now connects health, symaira_whoami, find_entries, get_entry_metadata, get_entry, get_entry_value and list_entries to the encrypted Store with profile scope, policy and audit. generate_password and guarded generate_totp return are also connected; clipboard/autotype destinations remain unavailable. Value reads cover quarantine, redaction, sealing, session counters and semantic injection modes through actual Go fixtures. Semantic log-only warnings now use stderr without the checked vault value. set_entry_field, delete_entry, get_auth_status symaira_audit_self, sanitize_output, symaira_search, search, fetch, list_shares and source-authorized revoke_share are also connected; generate_template supports masked built-in previews only; mutation handlers share the existing Git auto-commit helper with the CLI. Interactive approval and the remaining tools are incomplete; runtime refuses required unsupported approval. Full MCP-002/003 and native CI acceptance remain open. See resume-20260917.md.
